_note: Hand-maintained layer over the generated UI schema (DESIGN_PLAN 3.3/3.4, 11-P0). Keyed by catalog key. Everything here is DATA the builder bakes into ui_schema.json; the archetype/tier/danger/special-layout of a program is never code. Defaults the builder applies without an entry: archetype = grid_record when the program has a key field, else form; tier = 3 if danger else 1.
_field_meta_note: Per-field grouping + plain-English description for single-record form pages (Switchroom 2a System settings screen). Keyed catalog_key -> field name -> {group, desc}. The builder attaches group/desc onto the field; the UI groups by 'group' (first-appearance order) and falls back to an 'Advanced (N)' group for anything without one.
